newsitem.title: UK: Euro oil swaps ease back, bar firmer heavy fuel.
newsitem.headline: Euro oil swaps ease back, bar firmer heavy fuel.

text.p: European oil swaps were a touch easier on Wednesday, bar fuel which continues to resist the pulls and plays of the general energy complex.
Brent CFDs eased back a couple of cents after Tuesday's very strong showing. Dealers said some of the steam had been taken out of the market with screen crude easing back.
July 2-4 was pegged at -3/+1 cents against August Brent, July 7-11 at -3 cents and July 14-18 at -9/10 cents. No CFDs were heard traded.
Heavy fuel swaps gained up to 75 cents or so with July valued at $85, August between $85.50/$86 and September at about $87.25. Traders said activity was thin.
Gasoline swaps were about $1 weaker with July pegged around $188 and August and September showing $1 a piece backwardation.
Gas oil crack spreads were broadly steady with 4Q98 at $4.40, 1Q98 at $4.58 and 2Q98 at $4.10.
